pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Upgrade the station and follow this whiskey’s JEI recipe. A purchased bottle does not replace brewing it.

pages.title: Upgrade brewing equipment
pages.text: Upgrade Wooden Brewingstations to Copper and then Netherite at a Smithing Table. Higher tiers change the available recipes and manual upkeep.
